name: CreateMixStream

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain of the streamer.
<notice>Only domain names in the China (Shanghai) (cn-shanghai) and China (Beijing) (cn-beijing) regions are supported.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。
<notice>目前仅支持华东2（cn-shanghai）和华北2（cn-beijing）两个区域的域名。
</notice>
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The layout ID. Valid values:  
MixStreamLayout-1-1
MixStreamLayout-2-1
MixStreamLayout-2-2
MixStreamLayout-2-3
MixStreamLayout-3-1
MixStreamLayout-3-2
MixStreamLayout-4-1
USERDEFINED (for any layout other than the preset layouts listed above, set this parameter to USERDEFINED)
For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199359.html
parameters.help_zh:
布局ID。取值：  
MixStreamLayout-1-1
MixStreamLayout-2-1
MixStreamLayout-2-2
MixStreamLayout-2-3
MixStreamLayout-3-1
MixStreamLayout-3-2
MixStreamLayout-4-1
USERDEFINED（非上述预设布局，固定取值USERDEFINED）
更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199359.html
parameters.name: layout_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of input streams for stream mixing. JSON array.

Refer to InputStreamConfig below
parameters.help_zh:
合流输入列表。JSON数组。

参考下方的InputStreamConfig
parameters.name: input_stream_list

parameters.help_en:
The output configuration for stream mixing. The value is a JSON string.

Refer to OutputConfig below
parameters.help_zh:
合流输出配置。格式为JSON字符串。

参考下方的OutputConfig
parameters.name: output_config

parameters.help_en:
The callback URL. JSON array.
When an event occurs, the live streaming server sends an HTTP POST request to this URL. The specific content is delivered through the HTTP body
parameters.help_zh:
回调地址。JSON数组。
当事件产生时，直播服务端会向该地址发起HTTP POST请求，具体内容将通过HTTP Body送达
parameters.name: callback_config

MixStreamId.description_en: The stream mixing task ID. You can use this ID as a request parameter to query the stream mixing task list or delete a stream mixing task
MixStreamId.description_zh: 合流任务ID。可作为查询合流任务列表和删除合流任务的请求参数
